subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should OpenClaw merge the non-expiring three-attempt main-session recovery fuse and require `/new` or reset after the session is tombstoned?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and well-proven, but persisted session state and intentionally fail-closed recovery behavior are compatibility and operator-policy choices that green CI cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept the durable fuse
options.body: Merge after exact-head validation, accepting three charged attempts and explicit session replacement as the bounded recovery contract.

options.title: Revise the quarantine policy
options.body: Keep the architecture but change the attempt count, expiry, or operator recovery behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause the branch
options.body: Do not merge if maintainers prefer a narrower persisted schema or are unwilling to make automatic recovery fail closed.

recommendation.title: Accept the durable fuse
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head validation, accepting three charged attempts and explicit session replacement as the bounded recovery contract.
